channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Iran ready for doomsday war’, FM Araghchi says
item.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Iran is prepared for war to resume, ‘even if it comes to a doomsday war’.

item.title: Mike Waltz: US offered to sell Iran uranium for civilian programme
item.description: US ambassador says Iran refused to agree to an arrangement where uranium would be supplied by Washington.

item.title: Dozens killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
item.description: At least 27 people have been killed in two mass shootings across South Africa.

item.title: Afghanistan says 28 fighters killed as Islamabad, Kabul trade accusations
item.description: Relations strain further as Afghanistan and Pakistan trade accusations over terrorism and cross-border violence.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz tensions linger as Iran and US move further from a deal
item.description: There are fears of renewed fighting between the US and Iran, after President Trump rejected a deal.

item.title: ‘Better deal’: What’s behind Trump’s rejection of Iran’s truce offer?
item.description: Experts say Trump sees economic sanctions as key to extracting more concessions but he risks losing leverage.

item.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
item.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

item.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
item.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

item.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
item.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.
